paragraphs.source_en: Kōfu. In spring, messengers arrived one after another from the east; in autumn, an unending stream of messengers came from the west.

units.source_en: Kōfu.
units.source_zh: 甲府。

units.source_en: In spring, messengers arrived one after another from the east;
units.source_zh: 春季，东边来的使者接连不断；

units.source_en: in autumn, an unending stream of messengers came from the west.
units.source_zh: 秋季，西边来的使者络绎不绝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 甲府。春季，东边来的使者接连不断；秋季，西边来的使者络绎不绝。

paragraphs.source_en: Takeda Shingen, the tonsured lord entrenched in Kai and forever seeking an opportunity to march on the capital, had one mortal archenemy: none other than Uesugi Kenshin of Echigo. He seemed to delight in fighting Shingen; one might even say that, almost without intending it, he was forever obstructing Shingen’s road to the capital.

units.source_en: Takeda Shingen, the tonsured lord entrenched in Kai and forever seeking an opportunity to march on the capital, had one mortal archenemy: none other than Uesugi Kenshin of Echigo.
units.source_zh: 盘踞在甲斐、时刻寻找进京机会的武田入道信玄，有一个致命的宿敌，不是别人，正是越后的上杉谦信。

units.source_en: He seemed to delight in fighting Shingen; one might even say that, almost without intending it, he was forever obstructing Shingen’s road to the capital.

ja.t: しんでいるかのようであり、

units.source_zh: 他似乎以和信玄作战为乐，也可以说，他总是在不经意地阻碍信玄进京之途。

paragraphs.source_zh: 盘踞在甲斐、时刻寻找进京机会的武田入道信玄，有一个致命的宿敌，不是别人，正是越后的上杉谦信。他似乎以和信玄作战为乐，也可以说，他总是在不经意地阻碍信玄进京之途。

paragraphs.source_en: For more than twenty years, whenever the snow and ice blanketing the northern country melted away, Uesugi Kenshin would come to challenge him. He accepted none of the advantages offered by the Takeda and ignored every appeal for peace. Though a devotee of Zen, Uesugi possessed such fierce ardor that he nearly drove Shingen to despair.

units.source_en: For more than twenty years, whenever the snow and ice blanketing the northern country melted away, Uesugi Kenshin would come to challenge him.
units.source_zh: 二十多年以来，每当北国漫山遍野的冰雪融化后，上杉谦信总会前来挑战。

units.source_en: He accepted none of the advantages offered by the Takeda and ignored every appeal for peace.
units.source_zh: 他既不接受武田家提供的任何利益，对求和的要求也置之不理。

units.source_en: Though a devotee of Zen, Uesugi possessed such fierce ardor that he nearly drove Shingen to despair.
units.source_zh: 信奉禅宗的上杉却锐气逼人，几令信玄心灰意冷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十多年以来，每当北国漫山遍野的冰雪融化后，上杉谦信总会前来挑战。他既不接受武田家提供的任何利益，对求和的要求也置之不理。信奉禅宗的上杉却锐气逼人，几令信玄心灰意冷。

paragraphs.source_en: In the fourth year of Eiroku, Uesugi even rode alone into the Takeda camp at Kawanakajima and tried to kill Takeda Shingen with his cherished sword, Azuki Nagamitsu—a bizarre exploit that left the world aghast.

units.source_en: In the fourth year of Eiroku, Uesugi even rode alone into the Takeda camp at Kawanakajima and tried to kill Takeda Shingen with his cherished sword, Azuki Nagamitsu—a bizarre exploit that left the world aghast.
units.source_zh: 永禄四年，上杉甚至单骑闯入川中岛的武田大营，想用他那把爱刀“小豆长光”杀死武田信玄，其怪异作风让世人瞠目结舌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 永禄四年，上杉甚至单骑闯入川中岛的武田大营，想用他那把爱刀“小豆长光”杀死武田信玄，其怪异作风让世人瞠目结舌。

paragraphs.source_en: On that occasion, Shingen barely escaped with his life thanks to Western armor, though he was wounded in the wrist and shoulder. And it was not merely one or two blows—he endured eight in succession. Uesugi’s blade moved like lightning; even the Suwa Hosshō helmet of which Shingen was so proud received three blows.

units.source_en: On that occasion, Shingen barely escaped with his life thanks to Western armor, though he was wounded in the wrist and shoulder.
units.source_zh: 那时候，信玄凭借西洋军备好不容易躲过一劫，但手腕和肩膀都受了伤。

units.source_en: And it was not merely one or two blows—he endured eight in succession.
units.source_zh: 而且不是挨了一两刀，而是连挨了八刀。

units.source_en: Uesugi’s blade moved like lightning; even the Suwa Hosshō helmet of which Shingen was so proud received three blows.
units.source_zh: 上杉出刀的速度疾如闪电，连信玄一向引以为豪的诹访法性头盔都挨了三刀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 那时候，信玄凭借西洋军备好不容易躲过一劫，但手腕和肩膀都受了伤。而且不是挨了一两刀，而是连挨了八刀。上杉出刀的速度疾如闪电，连信玄一向引以为豪的诹访法性头盔都挨了三刀。

paragraphs.source_en: Shingen, who had long wished to march on the capital, was forced to divide his forces in two.

units.source_en: Shingen, who had long wished to march on the capital, was forced to divide his forces in two.
units.source_zh: 一直想进京的信玄，不得不将兵力一分为二。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一直想进京的信玄，不得不将兵力一分为二。

paragraphs.source_en: Shingen was already in his early fifties.

units.source_en: Shingen was already in his early fifties.
units.source_zh: 信玄已经五十出头。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信玄已经五十出头。

paragraphs.source_en: Altogether, he possessed a vast domain assessed at nearly 1.2 million koku. At a rate of 250 soldiers supported by every ten thousand koku, he already commanded an army of some thirty thousand. Yet Heaven still had not granted him the opportunity to march on the capital.

units.source_en: Altogether, he possessed a vast domain assessed at nearly 1.2 million koku.
units.source_zh: 全部加起来，他拥有近一百二十万石的庞大领地。

units.source_en: At a rate of 250 soldiers supported by every ten thousand koku, he already commanded an army of some thirty thousand.
units.source_zh: 按一万石领地供养二百五十名士兵计算，他已经拥有约三万大军。

units.source_en: Yet Heaven still had not granted him the opportunity to march on the capital.
units.source_zh: 但上天仍然没有给他进京的机会。

paragraphs.source_zh: 全部加起来，他拥有近一百二十万石的庞大领地。按一万石领地供养二百五十名士兵计算，他已经拥有约三万大军。但上天仍然没有给他进京的机会。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Shingen sat quietly in his bedchamber at Kai Castle, gazing through half-closed eyes at the crimson leaves on Mount Yōgai. He appeared free of every thought and desire. After fifty-two years amid the clash of arms, his life had acquired the weight of a mountain. He was deep in thought.

units.source_en: At that moment, Shingen sat quietly in his bedchamber at Kai Castle, gazing through half-closed eyes at the crimson leaves on Mount Yōgai.
units.source_zh: 此时，信玄正静静坐在甲斐城的卧房内，半睁着眼睛，眺望着要害山上的红叶。

units.source_en: He appeared free of every thought and desire.
units.source_zh: 他看上去无念无想。

units.source_en: After fifty-two years amid the clash of arms, his life had acquired the weight of a mountain.
units.source_zh: 五十二年的戎马生涯，他的人生厚重如山。

units.source_en: He was deep in thought.
units.source_zh: 他在深思。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，信玄正静静坐在甲斐城的卧房内，半睁着眼睛，眺望着要害山上的红叶。他看上去无念无想。五十二年的戎马生涯，他的人生厚重如山。他在深思。

paragraphs.source_en: Several retainers came to the doorway, but seeing Shingen immersed in meditation, they immediately withdrew without a sound.

units.source_en: Several retainers came to the doorway, but seeing Shingen immersed in meditation, they immediately withdrew without a sound.
units.source_zh: 几个家臣来到门口，看到信玄在冥想之中，立刻又悄没声地去了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 几个家臣来到门口，看到信玄在冥想之中，立刻又悄没声地去了。

paragraphs.source_en: The shrikes’ cries repeatedly broke the stillness of the autumn garden.

units.source_en: The shrikes’ cries repeatedly broke the stillness of the autumn garden.
units.source_zh: 伯劳鸟的声音不断打破秋日庭院的平静。

paragraphs.source_zh: 伯劳鸟的声音不断打破秋日庭院的平静。

paragraphs.source_en: “Is that Katsuyori?” At length Shingen finally spoke. “Has the secret envoy from Kaga arrived?”

units.source_en: “Is that Katsuyori?”
units.source_zh: “是胜赖？”

units.source_en: At length Shingen finally spoke. “Has the secret envoy from Kaga arrived?”
units.source_zh: 半晌，信玄终于开口，“加贺的密使到了吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是胜赖？”半晌，信玄终于开口，“加贺的密使到了吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori finally understood what his father had been pondering. “No. The man we sent to the Oda has returned.”

units.source_en: Katsuyori finally understood what his father had been pondering.
units.source_zh: 胜赖终于知道父亲刚才在思考些什么。

units.source_en: “No. The man we sent to the Oda has returned.”
units.source_zh: “不，是我们派往织田的人回来了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖终于知道父亲刚才在思考些什么。“不，是我们派往织田的人回来了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What of Nobunaga?”

units.source_en: “What of Nobunaga?”
units.source_zh: “信长怎样？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “信长怎样？”

paragraphs.source_en: “While coercing the shogun, he is hastening his preparations to attack Kawachi, Settsu, Yamato, Ōmi, and Echizen.”

units.source_en: “While coercing the shogun, he is hastening his preparations to attack Kawachi, Settsu, Yamato, Ōmi, and Echizen.”
units.source_zh: “他一面胁迫将军，一面加紧筹备，想进攻河内、摄津、大和、近江和越前。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “他一面胁迫将军，一面加紧筹备，想进攻河内、摄津、大和、近江和越前。”

paragraphs.source_en: Shingen opened his eyes wide and stared at Katsuyori, murmuring, “The time has come...”

units.source_en: Shingen opened his eyes wide and stared at Katsuyori, murmuring, “The time has come...”
units.source_zh: 信玄瞪大眼睛盯着信赖，低声说道：“时机到了……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 信玄瞪大眼睛盯着信赖，低声说道：“时机到了……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Just as you foresaw, the Miyoshi Triumvirate, Matsunaga of Yamato, Asakura of Echizen, Azai of Ōmi, the surviving Kitabatake faction in Ise, and the Sasaki-Rokkaku clan have all sent pledges. The shogun, too, eagerly awaits Father’s march on the capital.”

units.source_en: “Just as you foresaw, the Miyoshi Triumvirate, Matsunaga of Yamato, Asakura of Echizen, Azai of Ōmi, the surviving Kitabatake faction in Ise, and the Sasaki-Rokkaku clan have all sent pledges.
units.source_zh: “正如您所料，三好三人众、大和的松永、越前的朝仓、近江的浅井、伊势的北畠余众，还有佐佐木六角氏等都送来了誓约。

units.source_en: The shogun, too, eagerly awaits Father’s march on the capital.”
units.source_zh: 大将军也切盼父亲进京。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正如您所料，三好三人众、大和的松永、越前的朝仓、近江的浅井、伊势的北畠余众，还有佐佐木六角氏等都送来了誓约。大将军也切盼父亲进京。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Katsuyori, have Baba Nobuharu at Tanaka Castle and Yamagata Masakage at Ejiri Castle spread this news throughout Tokugawa territory.”

units.source_en: “Katsuyori, have Baba Nobuharu at Tanaka Castle and Yamagata Masakage at Ejiri Castle spread this news throughout Tokugawa territory.”
units.source_zh: “胜赖，让田中城的马场信春和江尻城的山县昌景将上述情况散布到德川领内。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “胜赖，让田中城的马场信春和江尻城的山县昌景将上述情况散布到德川领内。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Do you mean to make Ieyasu submit?” Katsuyori asked gravely. Shingen gently shook his head. “He will not surrender. He is a man who cannot read the times.”

units.source_en: “Do you mean to make Ieyasu submit?”

ja.t: させるおつもりですか」

units.source_zh: “您是想让家康归顺？”

units.source_en: Katsuyori asked gravely.
units.source_zh: 胜赖严肃地问道。

units.source_en: Shingen gently shook his head. “He will not surrender. He is a man who cannot read the times.”
units.source_zh: 信玄轻轻摇了摇头，“他不会投降，他是个不识时务之人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “您是想让家康归顺？”胜赖严肃地问道。信玄轻轻摇了摇头，“他不会投降，他是个不识时务之人。”

paragraphs.source_en: A faint, unconvinced smile appeared on Katsuyori’s face. Nevertheless, he answered obediently, “I shall see to it at once. But the alliance between Nobunaga and the Tokugawa is stronger than we imagined.”

units.source_en: A faint, unconvinced smile appeared on Katsuyori’s face.
units.source_zh: 胜赖脸上浮现出一丝笑意，好像不以为然。

units.source_en: Nevertheless, he answered obediently, “I shall see to it at once.
units.source_zh: 但他仍然顺从地答道：“儿子这就去办。

units.source_en: But the alliance between Nobunaga and the Tokugawa is stronger than we imagined.”
units.source_zh: 不过信长和德川家的同盟比我们想象中牢固。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖脸上浮现出一丝笑意，好像不以为然。但他仍然顺从地答道：“儿子这就去办。不过信长和德川家的同盟比我们想象中牢固。”

paragraphs.source_en: “That is precisely why I am having the rumors spread. Learning the enemy’s strength can have one of two effects: it may make a man shrink back, or it may make him more cautious. Inform me the moment the envoy from Kaga arrives. Until then, do not disturb my solitude.”

units.source_en: “That is precisely why I am having the rumors spread.
units.source_zh: “因此我才让人去散布传言。

units.source_en: Learning the enemy’s strength can have one of two effects: it may make a man shrink back, or it may make him more cautious.
units.source_zh: 了解敌人的强大，可能带来两种结果，一是因此畏缩不前，二是变得更加慎重。

units.source_en: Inform me the moment the envoy from Kaga arrives.
units.source_zh: 加贺的使者来后，立刻通知我。

units.source_en: Until then, do not disturb my solitude.”
units.source_zh: 在此之前，不要前来扰我清静。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “因此我才让人去散布传言。了解敌人的强大，可能带来两种结果，一是因此畏缩不前，二是变得更加慎重。加贺的使者来后，立刻通知我。在此之前，不要前来扰我清静。”

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori nodded but showed no intention of rising at once; his father’s attitude left him sullen. Nothing in this world was ever perfectly secure. Shogun Yoshiaki had repeatedly sent secret envoys urging his father to march on the capital, and an anti-Nobunaga alliance had already been formed. Katsuyori also believed that Nobunaga’s brutality was costing him the people’s support.

units.source_en: Katsuyori nodded but showed no intention of rising at once; his father’s attitude left him sullen.

ja.t: はうなずいたが、すぐに
がろうとはしなかった。

units.source_zh: 胜赖点点头，但并没有立刻起身之意，父亲的态度让他闷闷不乐。

units.source_en: Nothing in this world was ever perfectly secure. Shogun Yoshiaki had repeatedly sent secret envoys urging his father to march on the capital, and an anti-Nobunaga alliance had already been formed.
units.source_zh: 世间没有万全之事，将军义昭已多次派密使前来催促父亲进京，反信长的联盟也已结成。

units.source_en: Katsuyori also believed that Nobunaga’s brutality was costing him the people’s support.
units.source_zh: 胜赖还认为，信长的暴虐正让其失去民心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖点点头，但并没有立刻起身之意，父亲的态度让他闷闷不乐。世间没有万全之事，将军义昭已多次派密使前来催促父亲进京，反信长的联盟也已结成。胜赖还认为，信长的暴虐正让其失去民心。

paragraphs.source_en: In the ninth month of the second year of Genki, Nobunaga burned Mount Hiei, shocking the entire realm. Mount Hiei was the sacred ground that guarded the imperial capital. Yet Nobunaga burned the Konpon Chūdō and all twenty-one shrines of the Sannō complex, slaughtered monks on a vast scale, and thereby earned infamy as an enemy of Buddhism.

units.source_en: In the ninth month of the second year of Genki, Nobunaga burned Mount Hiei, shocking the entire realm.
units.source_zh: 信长于元龟二年九月火烧比睿山，让天下大为震惊。

units.source_en: Mount Hiei was the sacred ground that guarded the imperial capital.
units.source_zh: 比睿山是镇护王城的圣地。

units.source_en: Yet Nobunaga burned the Konpon Chūdō and all twenty-one shrines of the Sannō complex, slaughtered monks on a vast scale, and thereby earned infamy as an enemy of Buddhism.
units.source_zh: 信长却将其根本中堂、三王二十一社悉数烧毁，并大肆屠杀僧侣，从而得到佛敌的恶名。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长于元龟二年九月火烧比睿山，让天下大为震惊。比睿山是镇护王城的圣地。信长却将其根本中堂、三王二十一社悉数烧毁，并大肆屠杀僧侣，从而得到佛敌的恶名。

paragraphs.source_en: In short, this was an opportunity that came once in a thousand years—a perfect chance to destroy Nobunaga. Why, faced with such a splendid opportunity, did his father still hold his forces back? What could he be thinking?

units.source_en: In short, this was an opportunity that came once in a thousand years—a perfect chance to destroy Nobunaga.
units.source_zh: 总而言之，现在正是千载难逢的消灭信长的大好机会。

units.source_en: Why, faced with such a splendid opportunity, did his father still hold his forces back? What could he be thinking?
units.source_zh: 面对这样一个绝好机会，父亲却迟迟按兵不动，他究竟在想些什么呢？

paragraphs.source_zh: 总而言之，现在正是千载难逢的消灭信长的大好机会。面对这样一个绝好机会，父亲却迟迟按兵不动，他究竟在想些什么呢？

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori edged forward. “Father!”

units.source_en: Katsuyori edged forward. “Father!”
units.source_zh: 胜赖向前挪了挪，“父亲！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖向前挪了挪，“父亲！”

paragraphs.source_en: Shingen did not answer. He closed his eyes. In truth, he agreed with Katsuyori that the moment was ripe. Through fifty-two years of warfare, employing every means and expending all his strength and ingenuity, his ambition to march on the capital had never wavered. For that very reason, he had to proceed with greater caution now and make absolutely certain of success.

units.source_en: Shingen did not answer. He closed his eyes.
units.source_zh: 信玄没有回答，闭上了眼睛。

units.source_en: In truth, he agreed with Katsuyori that the moment was ripe.
units.source_zh: 其实他也和胜赖一样，认为现在正是好时机。

units.source_en: Through fifty-two years of warfare, employing every means and expending all his strength and ingenuity, his ambition to march on the capital had never wavered. For that very reason, he had to proceed with greater caution now and make absolutely certain of success.

ja.t: らがなかった。だからこそ
でなければならなかった。

units.source_zh: 经过五十二年战火，用尽手段，费尽心血，他进京的志向始终不曾动摇，所以在此时更应小心谨慎，以保万无一失。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信玄没有回答，闭上了眼睛。其实他也和胜赖一样，认为现在正是好时机。经过五十二年战火，用尽手段，费尽心血，他进京的志向始终不曾动摇，所以在此时更应小心谨慎，以保万无一失。

paragraphs.source_en: Every preparation was complete. On the eastern front, the Ashina, Satake, and Satomi had already been securely held in check; the western alliance, too, was virtually flawless. Shingen had also gathered Kitabatake rōnin and set them to foment disorder in Ise; and he was preparing to have naval forces strike Nobunaga from the rear.

units.source_en: Every preparation was complete.
units.source_zh: 一切准备都已就绪。

units.source_en: On the eastern front, the Ashina, Satake, and Satomi had already been securely held in check;
units.source_zh: 东线，已经牢牢牵制住苇名、佐竹、里见；

units.source_en: the western alliance, too, was virtually flawless.
units.source_zh: 西线联盟也堪称完美。

units.source_en: Shingen had also gathered Kitabatake rōnin and set them to foment disorder in Ise;
units.source_zh: 信玄还聚集起北畠的浪人，让他们在伊势作乱；

units.source_en: and he was preparing to have naval forces strike Nobunaga from the rear.
units.source_zh: 并准备让水军从背后袭击信长。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一切准备都已就绪。东线，已经牢牢牵制住苇名、佐竹、里见；西线联盟也堪称完美。信玄还聚集起北畠的浪人，让他们在伊势作乱；并准备让水军从背后袭击信长。

paragraphs.source_en: No warlord but Shingen was capable of arranging so immense a battlefront, stretching from Ōu to Shikoku. Yet Shingen remained uneasy. His greatest concern was Uesugi Kenshin of Echigo.

units.source_en: No warlord but Shingen was capable of arranging so immense a battlefront, stretching from Ōu to Shikoku.

units.source_en: Yet Shingen remained uneasy. His greatest concern was Uesugi Kenshin of Echigo.
units.source_zh: 但信玄还是不安，他最担心越后的上杉谦信。

paragraphs.source_en: Winter’s wind and snow could shield him from an Uesugi attack. But he could not recklessly leave Kōfu on that account alone. He was now plotting an Ikkō uprising in Kaga and Etchū, waiting for them to rise in revolt and halt Kenshin’s advance. All was ready; only the favorable wind was lacking.

units.source_en: Winter’s wind and snow could shield him from an Uesugi attack.

paragraphs.source_zh: 冬季的风雪，能够替他阻挡上杉的袭击。但他总不能因此贸然离开甲府。他现在正在策划加贺和越中一带的一向宗暴乱，正等着他们掀起暴乱，以阻挡谦信前进的步伐。万事俱备，只欠东风。

paragraphs.source_en: For Shingen, this would probably be the one and only march on the capital of his life. He meant to stake fifty-two years of experience and toil on this single campaign. If Kenshin could be contained as he hoped, victory would be almost his for the taking.

units.source_en: For Shingen, this would probably be the one and only march on the capital of his life.

paragraphs.source_en: Shingen’s lawful wife was the daughter of Sanjō Dainagon. Her younger sister had married into Ishiyama Hongan-ji. Shingen could not afford not to use this connection. It was through this tie that he could control the Ikkō adherents in Kaga and Etchū; if they learned that Shingen was about to march on the capital, the monks of Ishiyama Hongan-ji would surely attack Nobunaga from Osaka.

paragraphs.source_en: “If we let this opportunity slip away for nothing, we shall have to wait until next year... By then Nobunaga will have consolidated Yamato, Kawachi, and Settsu, and there will never be another chance.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Katsuyori, you are already twenty-seven this year. You must learn composure.”

units.source_en: “Katsuyori, you are already twenty-seven this year. You must learn composure.”
units.source_zh: “胜赖，你今年也已二十七岁了，要学会沉着。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “胜赖，你今年也已二十七岁了，要学会沉着。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Do you not trust the strength of the Ikkō sect?”

paragraphs.source_en: With eyes half closed, Shingen gently shook his head. “A flame kindled by outsiders is easily extinguished. I am waiting for them to kindle the fire of revolt of their own accord. Only then can Kenshin be stopped.” Shingen’s voice was grave, laden at once with anxiety and expectation.

units.source_zh: 信玄语气沉重，他心怀忧虑，又充满企盼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信玄半闭着眼，轻轻摇摇头，“外人点燃的火苗容易熄灭。我是在等待他们自发地燃起暴乱之火。只有那样，才能阻挡住谦信。”信玄语气沉重，他心怀忧虑，又充满企盼。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori had no reply. He bowed and withdrew.

units.source_en: Katsuyori had no reply. He bowed and withdrew.
units.source_zh: 胜赖无言以对，施了一礼，便离去了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖无言以对，施了一礼，便离去了。

paragraphs.source_en: Though Katsuyori closely resembled his mother in appearance, he believed that his character resembled his father Shingen’s. Even so, he harbored a measure of resentment toward his father. It was not because his father had killed Katsuyori’s maternal grandfather at a banquet; in an age of chaos, such bloodshed between father-in-law and son-in-law was hardly rare. Katsuyori’s maternal grandfather, Suwa Yorishige, was Shingen’s uncle by marriage. Thus Yorishige’s daughter, Lady Suwa—Katsuyori’s mother—and Shingen were in fact cousins.

units.source_en: Though Katsuyori closely resembled his mother in appearance, he believed that his character resembled his father Shingen’s.
units.source_zh: 胜赖的容貌虽然极像母亲，但他自认为个性和父亲信玄相似。

units.source_en: Even so, he harbored a measure of resentment toward his father.
units.source_zh: 尽管如此，他对父亲还是抱有些许不满。

units.source_en: It was not because his father had killed Katsuyori’s maternal grandfather at a banquet; in an age of chaos, such bloodshed between father-in-law and son-in-law was hardly rare.
units.source_zh: 倒不是因为父亲在酒宴上杀了胜赖的外祖父，这种翁婿相残之事在乱世并不少见。

units.source_en: Katsuyori’s maternal grandfather, Suwa Yorishige, was Shingen’s uncle by marriage.
units.source_zh: 胜赖的外祖父诹访赖茂是信玄的姑丈。

units.source_en: Thus Yorishige’s daughter, Lady Suwa—Katsuyori’s mother—and Shingen were in fact cousins.
units.source_zh: 因此，赖茂的女儿、胜赖的生母诹访夫人，和信玄其实是表兄妹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖的容貌虽然极像母亲，但他自认为个性和父亲信玄相似。尽管如此，他对父亲还是抱有些许不满。倒不是因为父亲在酒宴上杀了胜赖的外祖父，这种翁婿相残之事在乱世并不少见。胜赖的外祖父诹访赖茂是信玄的姑丈。因此，赖茂的女儿、胜赖的生母诹访夫人，和信玄其实是表兄妹。

paragraphs.source_en: His mother was Shingen’s favorite, and Katsuyori enjoyed more of his father’s affection than Tarō Yoshinobu, the son of the lawful wife. Consequently, Tarō Yoshinobu conspired with Imagawa Ujizane of Suruga to eliminate Shingen, but instead was thrown into prison and ultimately killed. Katsuyori formally became heir to the Takeda clan. That had happened when Katsuyori was twenty. At the time, he had worshiped his father.

units.source_en: His mother was Shingen’s favorite, and Katsuyori enjoyed more of his father’s affection than Tarō Yoshinobu, the son of the lawful wife.
units.source_zh: 母亲为信玄所宠，比起正室之子太郎义信，胜赖更得父亲的欢心。

units.source_en: Consequently, Tarō Yoshinobu conspired with Imagawa Ujizane of Suruga to eliminate Shingen, but instead was thrown into prison and ultimately killed.

units.source_zh: 因此太郎义信和骏河的今川氏真密谋，企图除掉信玄，却反被送进监牢，最终被杀死。

units.source_en: Katsuyori formally became heir to the Takeda clan.
units.source_zh: 胜赖正式成为武田氏的嗣子。

units.source_en: That had happened when Katsuyori was twenty.

units.source_en: At the time, he had worshiped his father.
units.source_zh: 那时，他对父亲顶礼膜拜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 母亲为信玄所宠，比起正室之子太郎义信，胜赖更得父亲的欢心。因此太郎义信和骏河的今川氏真密谋，企图除掉信玄，却反被送进监牢，最终被杀死。胜赖正式成为武田氏的嗣子。那是胜赖二十岁时发生的事情。那时，他对父亲顶礼膜拜。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori himself did not understand why his father favored him so greatly; he could only suppose that his intelligence and abilities more closely resembled his father’s. Lately, however, doubts had begun to trouble him.

units.source_en: Katsuyori himself did not understand why his father favored him so greatly; he could only suppose that his intelligence and abilities more closely resembled his father’s.
units.source_zh: 胜赖也不明白自己为何能得父亲如此宠爱，只得认为是自己的聪明才智更像父亲。

units.source_en: Lately, however, doubts had begun to trouble him.
units.source_zh: 但最近，他开始困惑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖也不明白自己为何能得父亲如此宠爱，只得认为是自己的聪明才智更像父亲。但最近，他开始困惑。

paragraphs.source_en: When his father named him heir, had he truly decided that Katsuyori alone could govern the Takeda house well? Now, it seemed, the matter required reconsideration.

units.source_en: When his father named him heir, had he truly decided that Katsuyori alone could govern the Takeda house well?

units.source_en: Now, it seemed, the matter required reconsideration.

paragraphs.source_zh: 父亲将他立为嗣子，真是考虑到只有他才能治理好武田家吗？现在看来，需要重新审视。

paragraphs.source_en: His father’s aim was, of course, to march on the capital and fulfill his long-cherished ambition of commanding the realm. And Katsuyori, as heir to the Takeda house, ought likewise to possess the stature to command the realm. But was that truly so? You are the man who will one day command the realm—did his father truly see Katsuyori that way?

units.source_en: His father’s aim was, of course, to march on the capital and fulfill his long-cherished ambition of commanding the realm.

units.source_zh: 父亲的目标当然是进京，实现号令天下的夙愿。

paragraphs.source_zh: 父亲的目标当然是进京，实现号令天下的夙愿。而武田家的继承人胜赖也该有号令天下的资格。但事实果真如此吗？你是未来号令天下之人——父亲真这样看待胜赖吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori’s answer was no. His father had probably cast aside Tarō Yoshinobu and chosen Katsuyori because the latter would be easier to command. Compared with his elder brother Tarō Yoshinobu, whose mother came from a court-noble family, his father felt more secure allowing Katsuyori, who carried the blood of Suwa in Shinano, to inherit the Takeda house. When Katsuyori realized this, a terrible chill seized his heart.

units.source_en: Katsuyori’s answer was no.
units.source_zh: 胜赖的答案是否定的。

units.source_en: His father had probably cast aside Tarō Yoshinobu and chosen Katsuyori because the latter would be easier to command.
units.source_zh: 父亲弃太郎义信而择胜赖，恐是出于方便“号令”的考虑。

units.source_en: Compared with his elder brother Tarō Yoshinobu, whose mother came from a court-noble family, his father felt more secure allowing Katsuyori, who carried the blood of Suwa in Shinano, to inherit the Takeda house.
units.source_zh: 比起生母出身于公卿之家的哥哥太郎义信，让具有信浓诹访血统的胜赖继承武田，父亲觉得更放心。

units.source_en: When Katsuyori realized this, a terrible chill seized his heart.
units.source_zh: 胜赖认识到这一点时，无比寒心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖的答案是否定的。父亲弃太郎义信而择胜赖，恐是出于方便“号令”的考虑。比起生母出身于公卿之家的哥哥太郎义信，让具有信浓诹访血统的胜赖继承武田，父亲觉得更放心。胜赖认识到这一点时，无比寒心。

paragraphs.source_en: Perhaps Katsuyori had come to this conclusion after seeing how excessively calculating Shingen had been over the marriage alliance with the Oda clan. Princess Yuki, Katsuyori’s lawful wife who had come from the Oda house, died not long after giving birth to Takeōmaru. When Princess Yuki gave birth to Takeōmaru, Shingen had seemed overjoyed and had even held a magnificent banquet for the occasion. Katsuyori could never forget any of it, yet Shingen seemed to have forgotten it completely.

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖想到此，或许是看到信玄在与织田氏联姻的问题上，显得过分工于心计。从织田家迎娶过来的胜赖正室雪姬，生下竹王丸不久就去世了。雪姬生竹王丸时，信玄看来满心欢喜，还专门举行了盛大的宴会。这一切胜赖都难以忘怀，但信玄好像已完全不记得了。

paragraphs.source_en: In such an age of chaos, one could not survive otherwise. But to regard the whole of life as nothing more than survival and exhaust every stratagem for that end was far too cruel, far too chilling. After marching on the capital, would his father summon him to Kyoto, or leave him in Kai to hold Shinano in check?

units.source_en: In such an age of chaos, one could not survive otherwise.
units.source_zh: 在这种乱世，若不如此就生存不下去。

paragraphs.source_en: From now on, he would take his destiny into his own hands. Deep within Katsuyori’s heart, another goal had already taken shape—one utterly different from his father’s.
